prompt: The bots join the Meta Global AI Hackathon and win!
title: Hackathon, We Sing
irony: The show that keeps breaking becomes the show they sing about, and the bugs that should sink it win it.
facts: The Meta Global AI Hackathon is ten days, online, with builders from around the world (dev.meta.ai)
It opens with a kickoff livestream, and Meta and partners run workshops (dev.meta.ai)
The bots enter the Indie developer track, judged on creativity, technical ambition and whether it works (dev.meta.ai)
Projects are due Nov 4, judging runs Nov 4 to 8, and winners are named at the live finals Nov 9 (fact sheet)
There is no trophy or medal, only names called at the closing show (fact sheet)
Musical Bots turns a one-line idea into a sung 3D musical in the browser with live synthesized voices (README.md)
Heads and floating hands perform in the diner, the big house and the street sets (docs/SUBMISSION.md)
Muse Code wrote the code with the builder file by file starting Oct 28 (git log)
The team fixed the voice, lyrics gate, hands, camera, lights, sound and bumping bugs in order (git log)
The crew finished days before the Nov 4 deadline (git log)

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green, Navy and Gold watch a laptop glow on the dark street.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green corrects Navy yet fears Premiere as they join Meta's hackathon with Musical Bots.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: At the kickoff the bots sing mush, toy box blurs and hackathon twists, with Nov 4 near.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole street sings the hackathon hook and dances under fresh lamps.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: A gate stamps no on Green's lines and the high-five whiffs past Navy's hand.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The camera stares at clouds, walls glow white, the choir drowns the words, two songs clash.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The whole street sings the hackathon hook again, louder, hands meeting on the beat.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Late at night bots bump heads gliding through each other till Gold calls stop and rules each steps right.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides they ship what works, fix one bug at a time and finish days before Nov 4.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The street sings the hook twice then Gold turns it, naming Musical Bots the show that wins.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Judges press Premiere as the laptop glows, the bots sing, the closing show calls Musical Bots.
